win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 Land 6 or more connecting symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.

scatters.name: BONUS WHEEL
scatters.behavior:
If 3 BONUS symbols land on the grid, the bonus game feature is triggered.
The bonus game consists of a bonus wheel with 8 sections. The player gets up to 50 spins.
Every time that the hit marker comes to a stop at a particular section of the wheel, the displayed multiplier is added to the total and the multiplier on that section is increased to the next level. All multipliers start at 1x and can increase to 10x, 25x, 100x and finally 250x.

The bonus feature stops once the wheel comes to a stop on the skull symbol. The total win will be calculated as the displayed total multiplier multiplied with the base game bet level.

specials.name: SPREADING SYMBOL
specials.behavior: Five spreading symbols trigger the compass in the logo. The needle starts to spin and once it stops all spreading symbols multiply and spread in the direction shown. Regular wins are awarded before the spreading feature is triggered.

modes.name: FREE SPINS
modes.trigger: If 3 FREE SPINS symbols land on the grid, the free spins feature is triggered.
modes.effects:
If 3 FREE SPINS symbols land on the grid, the free spins feature is triggered. In this mode, every time a spreading symbol lands on the grid the compass starts spinning. This feature has added spreading symbols on the reels. After the compass stops spinning, the spreading symbols will multiply and spread in the direction shown. Regular wins are awarded before the spreading feature is triggered.

3 FREE SPINS symbols award 10 free spins
